opening.argument: The presentation offers paid packages ranging from EUR 100 to EUR 5,000 and ties those purchases to projected account growth and substantial coin-price increases. It expressly compares a EUR 5,030 Tycoon purchase with a projected EUR 24,000 account value at the beginning of the price increase. The opportunity is also presented as a recruitment-linked business: viewers are urged to partner with the team, earnings are tied to lesser-team volume, and the plan is described as a binary compensation structure built through referrals. Those features make this a solicitation for participation, not merely a discussion of cryptocurrency. The statements that recruiting is unnecessary and that displayed values depend on predictions qualify the pitch but do not remove its paid package promotion, projected returns, or referral-based compensation.
